summary: Live location tracker web app using Leaflet.js to display real-time GPS position on an interactive map
architectural_notes: Uses Leaflet.js library for map rendering and GPS tracking
Browser Geolocation API with continuous watch mode
Single-page HTML app with embedded CSS and JavaScript

existing_features.title: Integrate Leaflet.js map library (version 1.9.4) using CDN (https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js and https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css) to render an interactive full-screen map with OpenStreetMap tiles (https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png with maxZoom: 19)

Implement browser Geolocation API tracking that continuously watches user position (watch: true), automatically centers the map on user location with zoom level 16, and updates a blue marker as position changes

Display a status overlay box positioned absolutely at top-right (10px from top and right) with white background, rounded corners (5px border-radius), and subtle shadow (0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)) showing: 'Location Tracker' heading, tracking status text ('Waiting for permission...', 'Tracking Active', or 'Error: Location denied'), and live latitude/longitude coordinates formatted to 5 decimal places

Apply a clean, modern minimal design aesthetic with a focus on functional clarity: use a crisp monochrome palette (white UI elements on transparent overlays), sans-serif typography (Arial), and subtle elevation through soft shadows to create visual hierarchy without distraction from the map content

new_feature_requests.summary: Display live GPS location on interactive map with real-time tracking
Show location status overlay with coordinates and tracking state
